items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: And the next Ed Robinson boy started out with him. Might have to pull a straw between the two of them but still I thought. They were both great huh?

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Robichaux was the other one?
Three brothers. Johnny, Ed, and... What's the other bass player there? I've forgotten his name.
The old dad. What was your favorite band, then, when you were going into town, like, once in a while, like that? Uh...
